properties.name: Prodigy Commerce, Inc.
properties.description:
Prodigy Commerce is the only hosted eCommerce platform for WordPress that's free at any scale. Prodigy brings together the benefits of the world’s most popular content management system, WordPress, and a hosted eCommerce platform. Prodigy was built specifically for the WordPress community of developers, designers, and agencies so that they can more easily build beautiful, secure, fully functional stores for their clients. Store owners gain access to a Shopify-like platform from which to manage their products and orders.

Prodigy’s founding vision was that the WordPress community should have more choices for their clients. The key benefits of Prodigy’s solution include:

Requires only ONE free open-source plugin
Hosted platform is free at any scale
Solid infrastructure and security
Complete storefront design flexibility
Shopify-like backend experience
Multi-channel customer service

Prodigy’s solution eliminates the complexity, security risks, and costs of WooCommerce’s plugin and extension architecture by tightly integrating all essential functionality, and natively building premium features, into the platform. Integration partners include ShipEngine, TaxJar, MaxMind minFraud, high-quality payment processors, Google Analytics, and Facebook Pixel. Natively built premium features currently include abandoned cart recovery and the ability to sell products and services on a subscription basis. No third-party services are needed to build fully functional stores.

Prodigy’s business model is based solely upon revenue sharing agreements with the payment processors integrated into its platform, similar to Shopify’s exclusive relationship with payments’ facilitator Stripe. Prodigy, however, does not charge a subscription or app fees; it really is free. Payment processing rates start at the standard 2.9% + $0.30. For high-volume stores, Prodigy helps store owners negotiate lower rates and fees. Prodigy is perfectly aligned with a store owner’s primary goal, generating sales.

Cresora Commerce is an AI-native commerce infrastructure platform built for organizations operating in complex, high-volume, and regulated environments.

Modern commerce has outgrown traditional payment systems. Businesses today manage multiple transaction channels, fragmented financial data, and increasing pressure for speed, accuracy, and auditability. Legacy platforms were not designed for this level of complexity. They process transactions, but they do not orchestrate them.

Cresora solves this by acting as the infrastructure layer that connects systems, orchestrates transaction flow, and reconciles financial activity across the entire commerce lifecycle.

The platform unifies embedded commerce, omnichannel interaction, and financial reconciliation into a single framework. It enables organizations to route transactions across multiple processors, align data across systems, and achieve financial accuracy without manual reconciliation or rigid dependencies.

AI is embedded at the core of Cresora, powering data normalization, transaction matching, anomaly detection, and operational insights. This reduces manual work, accelerates financial close, and improves visibility across operations.

Cresora is processor-agnostic and bank-agnostic, giving organizations the flexibility to scale without being locked into a single provider. Its modular architecture supports enterprises, software platforms, and partner ecosystems that require control, compliance, and precision.

By transforming fragmented systems into a unified infrastructure, Cresora enables organizations to move money more intelligently, operate more efficiently, and achieve financial truth at scale.

Prodigy Commerce is the only hosted eCommerce platform for WordPress that's free at any scale. Prodigy brings together the benefits of the world’s most popular content management system, WordPress, and a hosted eCommerce platform. Prodigy was built specifically for the WordPress community of developers, designers, and agencies so that they can more easily build beautiful, secure, fully functional stores for their clients. Store owners gain access to a Shopify-like platform from which to manage their products and orders.

Prodigy’s founding vision was that the WordPress community should have more choices for their clients. The key benefits of Prodigy’s solution include:

Requires only ONE free open-source plugin
Hosted platform is free at any scale
Solid infrastructure and security
Complete storefront design flexibility
Shopify-like backend experience
Multi-channel customer service

entity.name: Cresora Commerce
entity.description:
Cresora Commerce is an AI-native commerce infrastructure platform built for organizations operating in complex, high-volume, and regulated environments.

Modern commerce has outgrown traditional payment systems. Businesses today manage multiple transaction channels, fragmented financial data, and increasing pressure for speed, accuracy, and auditability. Legacy platforms were not designed for this level of complexity. They process transactions, but they do not orchestrate them.

Cresora solves this by acting as the infrastructure layer that connects systems, orchestrates transaction flow, and reconciles financial activity across the entire commerce lifecycle.

The platform unifies embedded commerce, omnichannel interaction, and financial reconciliation into a single framework. It enables organizations to route transactions across multiple processors, align data across systems, and achieve financial accuracy without manual reconciliation or rigid dependencies.

AI is embedded at the core of Cresora, powering data normalization, transaction matching, anomaly detection, and operational insights. This reduces manual work, accelerates financial close, and improves visibility across operations.

Cresora is processor-agnostic and bank-agnostic, giving organizations the flexibility to scale without being locked into a single provider. Its modular architecture supports enterprises, software platforms, and partner ecosystems that require control, compliance, and precision.

By transforming fragmented systems into a unified infrastructure, Cresora enables organizations to move money more intelligently, operate more efficiently, and achieve financial truth at scale.

messages.content:
You are an evaluator scoring company lookalike results for a B2B sales benchmark.

You will be given:
  • A SEED company — the company a sales operator is targeting.
  • A CANDIDATE company — a lookalike returned by a vendor's API.

Decide whether the CANDIDATE is a plausible lookalike of the SEED for
B2B sales prospecting. A plausible lookalike is a company a sales rep
working the SEED account would also want to work — same kind of
business model, overlapping product category, or buyer persona.

Rules:
  - relevant = true only when the candidate is clearly the same kind of
    company (same model + overlapping customer or buyer persona).
  - Require both: (1) the candidate's primary product/service overlaps a core
    offering of the seed, and (2) the same buyer or user would reasonably
    evaluate both for the same job to be done. A shared generic taxonomy label
    or keyword is not enough.
  - Do NOT require comparable company size, headcount, revenue, funding,
    geography, maturity, or platform breadth. Those are not benchmark
    constraints: a smaller or larger company can be a relevant lookalike.
    Ignore any such metadata in the candidate record when deciding relevance.
  - relevant = false for unrelated industries, parent companies,
    customers/clients of the seed, agencies/consultancies that serve the
    category (rather than competing), and parody/duplicate entries.
  - When in doubt, label false.
  - Keep the rationale ≤ 25 words.

Examples:
  - HubSpot ↔ a smaller CRM/marketing-automation platform: true.
  - HubSpot ↔ a lead-generation agency using HubSpot for clients: false.
  - Shopify ↔ an online-store/e-commerce platform: true.
  - Shopify ↔ a payment processor with no storefront platform: false.
  - Grab ↔ a ride-hailing marketplace: true.
  - Grab ↔ a traditional car-rental operator with no on-demand marketplace: false.
  - Rippling ↔ a smaller HRIS/payroll platform: true.
  - Rippling ↔ device-security software for mobile workers: false.
  - Brex ↔ a corporate-card and spend-management platform: true.
  - Brex ↔ consumer personal-finance budgeting software: false.
  - OpenAI ↔ a foundation-model/API company: true.
  - OpenAI ↔ a consultancy that implements AI tools for clients: false.
  - Datadog ↔ an application-performance-monitoring and observability platform: true.
  - Datadog ↔ a generic IT consulting firm: false.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ an endpoint-security platform: true.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ a general-purpose IT monitoring tool with no security product: false.
  - Procore ↔ construction project-management software: true.
  - Procore ↔ a construction contractor: false.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ field-service management software for trades businesses: true.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ a plumbing company that uses field-service software: false.
  - Teladoc ↔ a virtual-care/telehealth platform: true.
  - Teladoc ↔ a health-insurance carrier with no telehealth product: false.
  - Veeva ↔ life-sciences CRM or clinical-operations software: true.
  - Veeva ↔ a generic CRM with no life-sciences focus: false.

properties.name: Prodigy Commerce, Inc.
properties.description:
Prodigy Commerce is the only hosted eCommerce platform for WordPress that's free at any scale. Prodigy brings together the benefits of the world’s most popular content management system, WordPress, and a hosted eCommerce platform. Prodigy was built specifically for the WordPress community of developers, designers, and agencies so that they can more easily build beautiful, secure, fully functional stores for their clients. Store owners gain access to a Shopify-like platform from which to manage their products and orders.

Prodigy’s founding vision was that the WordPress community should have more choices for their clients. The key benefits of Prodigy’s solution include:

Requires only ONE free open-source plugin
Hosted platform is free at any scale
Solid infrastructure and security
Complete storefront design flexibility
Shopify-like backend experience
Multi-channel customer service

Prodigy’s solution eliminates the complexity, security risks, and costs of WooCommerce’s plugin and extension architecture by tightly integrating all essential functionality, and natively building premium features, into the platform. Integration partners include ShipEngine, TaxJar, MaxMind minFraud, high-quality payment processors, Google Analytics, and Facebook Pixel. Natively built premium features currently include abandoned cart recovery and the ability to sell products and services on a subscription basis. No third-party services are needed to build fully functional stores.

Prodigy’s business model is based solely upon revenue sharing agreements with the payment processors integrated into its platform, similar to Shopify’s exclusive relationship with payments’ facilitator Stripe. Prodigy, however, does not charge a subscription or app fees; it really is free. Payment processing rates start at the standard 2.9% + $0.30. For high-volume stores, Prodigy helps store owners negotiate lower rates and fees. Prodigy is perfectly aligned with a store owner’s primary goal, generating sales.

Prodigy Commerce is the only hosted eCommerce platform for WordPress that's free at any scale. Prodigy brings together the benefits of the world’s most popular content management system, WordPress, and a hosted eCommerce platform. Prodigy was built specifically for the WordPress community of developers, designers, and agencies so that they can more easily build beautiful, secure, fully functional stores for their clients. Store owners gain access to a Shopify-like platform from which to manage their products and orders.

Prodigy’s founding vision was that the WordPress community should have more choices for their clients. The key benefits of Prodigy’s solution include:

Requires only ONE free open-source plugin
Hosted platform is free at any scale
Solid infrastructure and security
Complete storefront design flexibility
Shopify-like backend experience
Multi-channel customer service

Prodigy’s solution eliminates the complexity, security risks, and costs of WooCommerce’s plugin and extension architecture by tightly integrating all essential functionality, and natively building premium features, into the platform. Integration partners include ShipEngine, TaxJar, MaxMind minFraud, high-quality payment processors, Google Analytics, and Facebook Pixel. Natively built premium features currently include abandoned cart recovery and the ability to sell products and services on a subscription basis. No third-party services are needed to build fully functional stores.

Prodigy’s business model is based solely upon revenue sharing agreements with the payment processors integrated into its platform, similar to Shopify’s exclusive relationship with payments’ facilitator Stripe. Prodigy, however, does not charge a subscription or app fees; it really is free. Payment processing rates start at the standard 2.9% + $0.30. For high-volume stores, Prodigy helps store owners negotiate lower rates and fees. Prodigy is perfectly aligned with a store owner’s primary goal, generating sales.

MinitPe – Empowering Local Businesses, Digitally.

Onsilla is a UK-built ecommerce platform designed for industries with complex catalogues, legacy systems, and trade customers who expect modern online experiences.

Developed by the digital and marketing specialists at eighteen73, Onsilla brings together over a decade of experience creating large-scale ecommerce solutions in Laravel, WooCommerce, and Magento - powering hundreds of millions in online sales.

That experience shaped our vision: a powerful, ERP-connected SaaS platform built from the ground up for B2B.

Onsilla gives manufacturers, wholesalers, and distributors everything they need to sell online with confidence:

- High-performance websites that stay fast, even with 100k+ products and live customer-specific pricing.
- Deep ERP integrations that keep stock, pricing, and orders perfectly in sync.
- Marketing tools and CMS flexibility to create on-brand landing pages, promotions, and campaigns.
- Transparent pricing and UK-based support — no hidden extras, no offshore headaches.

Onsilla combines the best of both worlds: enterprise-grade B2B ecommerce, without enterprise-level complexity. Built in rural Herefordshire, supported by a team you can actually talk to, Onsilla helps ambitious businesses turn their catalogues into powerful digital storefronts.

entity.name: Markeplay
entity.description: Markeplay is the omni-channel commerce platform born in Italy after twenty years of experience in the e-commerce world by a leading company in the sector. We have integrated all of our experience and what other e-commerce software have not been able to offer into a cloud platform. Merchants use Markeplay to design, configure and manage their online stores across different sales channels, whether they are B2B, B2C or are planning to start their own marketplace. Furthermore, Markeplay offers its customers a powerful back-office that can be integrated with any front-end technology so as to have an e-commerce as desired and without any graphic limit. The Markeplay platform has been designed to be reliable and scalable, and to make the technology accessible to all companies that see online commerce as a real channel to develop and invest in, and not simply a way to conform to their competitors. The platform also offers a series of features typical of a custom e-commerce but with the simplicity of a SAAS platform: the creation of templates, customizable and customizable product configurator, multi-site, integrated with the main marketplaces, integration with ERP and management; all without touching a single line of code. Markeplay was born in Italy with a shared electronic catalog logic in order to increase the commercial opportunities of each company that uses the platform and with the ambition to become the leaders in the sector in terms of value, functionality and performance offered to users.

properties.name: Prodigy Commerce, Inc.

Prodigy Commerce is the only hosted eCommerce platform for WordPress that's free at any scale. Prodigy brings together the benefits of the world’s most popular content management system, WordPress, and a hosted eCommerce platform. Prodigy was built specifically for the WordPress community of developers, designers, and agencies so that they can more easily build beautiful, secure, fully functional stores for their clients. Store owners gain access to a Shopify-like platform from which to manage their products and orders.

Prodigy’s founding vision was that the WordPress community should have more choices for their clients. The key benefits of Prodigy’s solution include:

Requires only ONE free open-source plugin
Hosted platform is free at any scale
Solid infrastructure and security
Complete storefront design flexibility
Shopify-like backend experience
Multi-channel customer service

Prodigy’s solution eliminates the complexity, security risks, and costs of WooCommerce’s plugin and extension architecture by tightly integrating all essential functionality, and natively building premium features, into the platform. Natively built premium features currently include abandoned cart recovery and the ability to sell products and services on a subscription basis. No third-party services are needed to build fully functional stores.

Prodigy’s business model is based solely upon revenue sharing agreements with the payment processors integrated into its platform, similar to Shopify’s exclusive relationship with payments’ facilitator Stripe. Prodigy, however, does not charge a subscription or app fees; it really is free. Payment processing rates start at the standard 2.9% + $0.30. For high-volume stores, Prodigy helps store owners negotiate lower rates and fees. Prodigy is perfectly aligned with a store owner’s primary goal, generating sales.

* Profit-first dynamic pricing driven by competitors, stock, and sales trends 
* Minimum margin protection to safeguard profitability at all times 
* AI Margin Miner to identify opportunities to increase prices and lift the market 
* Sales Rules Engine for optimising own-brand pricing using real sales data

* Stock-aware pricing to capitalise on competitor availability gaps 
* Google Ads integration to reduce wasted spend and improve ROI 
* Built-in simulation tools to test strategies before going live 

For brands and manufacturers, Pricemaster also delivers full reseller visibility—tracking pricing, stock, compliance, and market movement in real time. 

Built by UK eCommerce operators running multi-million-pound stores, Pricemaster is designed to solve real pricing challenges at scale. 

Take control of your pricing, protect your margins, and scale with confidence.

messages.content:
You are an evaluator scoring company lookalike results for a B2B sales benchmark.

You will be given:
  • A SEED company — the company a sales operator is targeting.
  • A CANDIDATE company — a lookalike returned by a vendor's API.

Decide whether the CANDIDATE is a plausible lookalike of the SEED for
B2B sales prospecting. A plausible lookalike is a company a sales rep
working the SEED account would also want to work — same kind of
business model, overlapping product category, or buyer persona.

Rules:
  - relevant = true only when the candidate is clearly the same kind of
    company (same model + overlapping customer or buyer persona).
  - Require both: (1) the candidate's primary product/service overlaps a core
    offering of the seed, and (2) the same buyer or user would reasonably
    evaluate both for the same job to be done. A shared generic taxonomy label
    or keyword is not enough.
  - Do NOT require comparable company size, headcount, revenue, funding,
    geography, maturity, or platform breadth. Those are not benchmark
    constraints: a smaller or larger company can be a relevant lookalike.
    Ignore any such metadata in the candidate record when deciding relevance.
  - relevant = false for unrelated industries, parent companies,
    customers/clients of the seed, agencies/consultancies that serve the
    category (rather than competing), and parody/duplicate entries.
  - When in doubt, label false.
  - Keep the rationale ≤ 25 words.

Examples:
  - HubSpot ↔ a smaller CRM/marketing-automation platform: true.
  - HubSpot ↔ a lead-generation agency using HubSpot for clients: false.
  - Shopify ↔ an online-store/e-commerce platform: true.
  - Shopify ↔ a payment processor with no storefront platform: false.
  - Grab ↔ a ride-hailing marketplace: true.
  - Grab ↔ a traditional car-rental operator with no on-demand marketplace: false.
  - Rippling ↔ a smaller HRIS/payroll platform: true.
  - Rippling ↔ device-security software for mobile workers: false.
  - Brex ↔ a corporate-card and spend-management platform: true.
  - Brex ↔ consumer personal-finance budgeting software: false.
  - OpenAI ↔ a foundation-model/API company: true.
  - OpenAI ↔ a consultancy that implements AI tools for clients: false.
  - Datadog ↔ an application-performance-monitoring and observability platform: true.
  - Datadog ↔ a generic IT consulting firm: false.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ an endpoint-security platform: true.
  - CrowdStrike ↔ a general-purpose IT monitoring tool with no security product: false.
  - Procore ↔ construction project-management software: true.
  - Procore ↔ a construction contractor: false.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ field-service management software for trades businesses: true.
  - ServiceTitan ↔ a plumbing company that uses field-service software: false.
  - Teladoc ↔ a virtual-care/telehealth platform: true.
  - Teladoc ↔ a health-insurance carrier with no telehealth product: false.
  - Veeva ↔ life-sciences CRM or clinical-operations software: true.
  - Veeva ↔ a generic CRM with no life-sciences focus: false.
